memory_time.note: torch/onnxruntime are absent from this dev environment. The sibling model-eval PoC (torch 2.10 CPU + sentence-transformers) measured peak RSS 556-2846 MB: minilm 556 MB, bekko-17m 624 MB, ettin-150m 991 MB, decider-nano 1464 MB, GLiDE 2846 MB. GLiDE exceeds the runner's 2048 MB RLIMIT_AS; decider-nano is close. The model-eval research also notes bekko's upstream ONNX browser model is ~29 MB versus 67 MB safetensors, so an ONNX path is plausible; however ONNX Runtime is expected to avoid torch's import/framework overhead and lower peak RSS only as an unverified hypothesis. I5 must benchmark the chosen model under RLIMIT_AS=2048 in the pylint subprocess and prefer ONNX only if it fits without raising the runner cap.
memory_time.three_load_note: The runner invokes pylint, pylint-pyi and pylint tests as three sequential subprocesses. A model backend is loaded lazily per process, so up to three model loads per lint run unless every suppression is a cache hit. Cache hits avoid model load entirely; refresh should populate the tracked cache before normal lint in CI.
